title: Chain Business + Specific Location Modifier
description: Rules for evaluating map results when the user queries a chain business with a specific location modifier such as a street address, intersection, or named building (e.g., 'McDonald's at 123 Main Street', 'Starbucks on 5th and Broadway').

decision_logic.condition: Result is NOT the queried chain
decision_logic.notes: Must be the correct chain brand

decision_logic.condition: Result IS the queried chain AND location matches the specific address/intersection exactly
decision_logic.notes: Exact chain match at exact specified location — perfect result

decision_logic.condition: Result IS the queried chain AND is the closest location to the specified address
decision_logic.notes: Correct chain, closest to specified address but not exact match

decision_logic.condition: Result IS the queried chain AND is in the same neighborhood as the specified address, but not the closest
decision_logic.notes: Correct chain, in the general area but not closest to specified location

decision_logic.condition: Result IS the queried chain but is in a different neighborhood from the specified address
decision_logic.notes: Correct chain but wrong area relative to the specific modifier

exceptions: If no location of the chain exists within a wide radius of the specified address, nearest may rate Excellent
Intersections are considered exact if the result is on one of the specified streets at that intersection

calibration_examples.reasoning: Exact chain at exact specified address — step 2 applies

conditions: Closest Subway to specified intersection but not exact
calibration_examples.reasoning: Closest Subway to specified intersection — step 3 applies

calibration_examples.result: Taco Bell on Oak Ave (different neighborhood)
calibration_examples.reasoning: Wrong neighborhood relative to specified street — step 5 applies
